A guide to ownership, borrowing and &mut.

Ownership rules

  • Each value has an owner.
  • Only one owner at a time
    • moved on assignment

    • dropped at scope end

Borrowing

References let you use a value
without taking it.

fn main() {
    let s = String::from("hi");
    println!("{}", &s);
}

At any time, one mutable reference or many immutable ones.
